text.p: Moody's Investor Service said it upgraded the long-term debt of Ciba-Geigy AG to Aaa from Aa3 and assigned Aaa ratings to the long-term debt of Sandoz AG.

"The rating actions anticipate that the upcoming merger of the two companies into a new entity to be named Novartis will be finalised substantially as currently proposed," Moody's said in a statement from New York which was released in Zurich.

Moody's said in its statement that the ratings recognise the outstanding financial strength of the new enterprise as well as the stronger and formidable business positions in pharmaceuticals and agrochemicals to be created by the merger of the two companies.
It said the rating actions conclude a review begun on March 7, 1996 when plans of the merger were announced.
The Prime-1 ratings for commercial paper of the supported entities of both Ciba-Geigy and Sandoz were confirmed at that time, Moody's said.
